test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Rajesh was angry __at__ himself for making a silly mistake during the examination.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'with.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in Part (**at**) of the sentence.
